findings.body:
**Reject inherited serialization hooks on arrays.**

At `src/shared/jsonLossless.ts:32`, an array subclass bypasses the prototype check. For `class A extends Array { toJSON() { return []; } }`, `new A(1, 2)` passes this validator, but serializes as `[]`. JSON serialization invokes inherited `toJSON` methods. ([tc39.es](https://tc39.es/ecma262/2024/multipage/structured-data.html))

The own-key scan cannot detect this hook. Reject unsupported array prototypes or inherited serialization hooks before accepting the array.
